card.name: Crop growing and harvest text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (from, until, of, a comma) in farming or crop-production passages, where a word like cultivation, planting or acreage is likely to come next.

modes.label: Harvest and area figures
modes.description: Linking word right after harvested or a production statistic, before an area or growing term.
modes.example: harvested<< from>> 2 million hectares. China was by

modes.label: Growing and producing plants
modes.description: Verbs or small words in text about crops, grass, or planted produce.
modes.example: early settlers<< planted>> them throughout the East Coast.

modes.label: Producer lists
modes.description: Comma in a list of leading producing regions.
modes.example: Florida, California<<,>> Georgia, and Michigan are generally leading producers

card.writes: It pushes the model toward farming words such as planting, cultivation, plantation and acre.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in passages about growing and harvesting crops, getting ready for farming terms.
